sections.markdown:
# Verify list

Preserve the registered source effective-date, retrieval-evidence and rights-review debts. All BAC thresholds and legal consequences retain current issuer/legal review debt; thresholds do not define a safe alcohol dose or guarantee lawful driving below them. The source gives fixed hourly alcohol removal and one-drink-per-hour waiting advice, a fixed cannabis effect duration and claims visible impairment after every drink; these are not adopted as biological guarantees or driving-clearance formulas. The felony-record voting prohibition is an overbroad civic-rights claim and is withheld. Exact DWI fine, jail, treatment, suspension, SR-22/security and homicide/injury penalty tables require current statute and exception review rather than automatic teaching. Commercial BAC rules are outside Class E scope. Dated fatalities, cost and prevalence statistics remain unasserted. Keep every stated condition attached to its page-cited rule. Unknown examination count and duration remain null. Revision frequency has not been established and the blocked-probe declaration remains. Independent source and factual review must address these precise points; authored market and competitor gaps remain separate from driving facts.

corpus_stability.reason: Registered handbook snapshot only; effective-date, rights, source freshness and independent factual review debts remain. No unsupported revision-frequency claim.
